territorial_scope.description: Amends the New Hampshire Revised Statutes and applies within New Hampshire; no reach beyond the state is stated.

evidence.quote: Amend RSA 638 by inserting after section 26 the following new section:

summary.short: Adds to New Hampshire law a class B felony for knowingly creating, distributing or presenting deepfakes to embarrass, harass, defame, extort or cause financial or reputational harm, plus a private civil action for such use and a lobbyist-registration bar. Effective January 1, 2025.
summary.long: Adds RSA 638:26-a, defining 'artificial intelligence' and 'deepfake' (digitally altered media of a person appearing to say or do what they never said or did), and making it a class B felony to knowingly create, distribute or present a deepfake of an identifiable individual to embarrass, harass, entrap, defame, extort or otherwise cause financial or reputational harm. Paragraph III creates a separate class B felony where the deepfake results in the person's arrest, with liability for the victim's legal expenses. Paragraph IV exempts interactive computer services for third-party content, bona fide news reports acknowledging authenticity questions, paid election communications that keep the sponsor's disclaimer, and satire or parody not dependent on AI. Adds RSA 507:8-j, a parallel civil action for damages against anyone who knowingly uses a person's likeness to create such a deepfake, with the same exemptions. Section 3 bars the secretary of state from accepting lobbyist registration of anyone convicted under RSA 638:26-a or found liable under RSA 507:8-j relating to lobbying. Severability clauses apply to both new sections. Effective January 1, 2025; approved July 19, 2024.

notes: Definitions of 'Artificial intelligence' and 'Deepfake' (I(a)-(b)), the exemptions and the severability clause are repeated almost verbatim in RSA 638:26-a and RSA 507:8-j; the civil action in 507:8-j II is limited to use 'to create a deepfake' and does not reference the criminal offense. obligations.summary: A person may not knowingly create, distribute or present a deepfake likeness of an identifiable individual for the purpose of embarrassing, harassing, entrapping, defaming, extorting or otherwise causing financial or reputational harm. The conduct is an offence (class B felony); the penalty is enforcement and is not coded here. Scope exemptions in para. IV are not coded as obligations.
